title: New charge
accounting_notes: This is a charge-posting screen with an explicit GL coding and a running-balance preview. GL account field reads exactly "4000 — Maintenance Fee Income" — a revenue account, so posting this charge credits 4000 Maintenance Fee Income for $15,000.00 and debits the Accounts Receivable / member dues control account for the unit (Phase 2 · Lot 47 — Andrea Fletcher). The charge type is "Special assessment" and the amount is "$15,000.00" (two-decimal form in the form field). The "Ledger preview" panel is the unit's receivable sub-ledger running balance, shown in whole-dollar form without decimals: "Current balance" $12,400; "+ New charge" $15,000; a border-top rule then "New balance" $27,400. New balance is DERIVED: 12,400 + 15,000 = 27,400, i.e. opening unit AR balance plus the new debit. The preview note states the charge "is added to her existing 30-day ageing bucket" — so the ageing schedule buckets by days outstanding and this charge lands in the 30-day bucket rather than starting a new current bucket, even though its due date is "Oct 15, 2026". Ties: unit ledger balance ($27,400) must equal the sum of the unit's posted charges less payments; the 4000 revenue credit must tie to the AR control account total across all units; the $15,000.00 form amount and the $15,000 preview line are the same figure formatted differently and must not diverge.

New charge

; there is no .top-right. The .content holds one .form-layout grid (1.2fr 1fr, gap 18px). LEFT .form-panel, in order: a .seg with three .seg-item — "Single unit" carrying .active, "Whole phase", "Whole estate"; a full-width .m-field (label "Unit", .m-input.focused span "Phase 2 · Lot 47 — Andrea Fletcher"); a .m-two-col row of two .m-field (label "Charge type", .m-input span "Special assessment"; label "Amount", .m-input span "$15,000.00"); a full-width .m-field (label "Description", .m-input span "Perimeter wall repair — Phase 2 special levy"); a second .m-two-col row of two .m-field (label "Due date", .m-input containing a calendar svg — rect x=3 y=5 w=18 h=16 rx=2 plus "M3 10h18M8 3v4M16 3v4" — then span "Oct 15, 2026"; label "GL account", .m-input span "4000 — Maintenance Fee Income"); then a .stack-btn.primary with inline width:100% holding a plus svg and Post charge. RIGHT .preview-panel: .preview-head "Ledger preview"; then an inline-styled box (background:var(--navy-100);border-radius:12px;padding:13px) with three flex rows — "Current balance" / $12,400, "+ New charge" / $15,000, and a bold 13px row separated by border-top:1px solid var(--navy-200) reading "New balance" / $27,400; below the box a .preview-note: "Andrea will see this on her Dues statement and get a push notification. It's added to her existing 30-day ageing bucket."
domain_needs: charge.scope — enum with three values "Single unit" (active default), "Whole phase", "Whole estate"; drives whether unit_id, phase_id or estate_id is required
charge.unit_id — displayed as "Phase 2 · Lot 47 — Andrea Fletcher", a composite of phase.name + middot + unit.lot_number + em-dash + primary resident full_name
charge.type — "Special assessment" (a charge_type lookup with at least maintenance fee and special assessment values)
charge.amount — 15000.00, rendered "$15,000.00" with thousands separator and two decimals in the form
charge.description — "Perimeter wall repair — Phase 2 special levy"
charge.gl_account_id — account code "4000" with name "Maintenance Fee Income", displayed as "4000 — Maintenance Fee Income"
gl_account.code + gl_account.name + gl_account.type (revenue) for the account picker
unit_ledger.current_balance — $12,400 before posting (derived from prior charges less payments)
unit_ledger.new_balance — $27,400, DERIVED as current balance 12,400 + new charge 15,000; must not be stored independently
money display formats differ: form amount two decimals ($15,000.00) vs preview whole dollars ($12,400 / $15,000 / $27,400)
journal_entry + journal_line entities: posting creates a credit to 4000 Maintenance Fee Income and a debit to the AR/dues control account for the unit
ageing_bucket assignment — the note says the charge joins the unit's existing "30-day ageing bucket"; needs bucket boundaries (current/30/60/90+) and a rule for which bucket a new charge inherits
notification: resident push notification on charge posted, plus visibility on the resident Dues statement
charge.posted_at + posted_by (Tracey Reid, Treasurer & Accountant) for the audit trail
